content: Senior Software Engineer salary in Ho Chi Minh City: 30-50 million VND/month (1,200-2,000 USD). With 5+ years experience and strong tech stack (React, Node.js, AWS), range increases to 40-60 million VND.
Mid-level Software Engineer (2-5 years) in Hanoi: 20-35 million VND/month. Frontend specialists with React/Vue command 10-15% premium over backend-only developers.
Product Manager salary range in Vietnam: Junior (1-3 years): 25-40M VND, Mid (3-5 years): 40-65M VND, Senior (5+ years): 60-100M VND. B2B SaaS companies offer 20% higher than average.
Data Scientist/ML Engineer salaries: Junior: 20-35M VND, Mid: 35-55M VND, Senior: 55-90M VND. PhD holders command 15-25% premium. Python, TensorFlow, and cloud ML platforms are key salary drivers.
DevOps Engineer compensation: Mid-level (3-5 years) with Kubernetes and AWS: 35-50M VND. Senior (5+ years) with multi-cloud expertise: 50-75M VND. On-call responsibilities add 10-15% to base salary.
Location adjustment factors for Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh City (baseline 1.0x), Hanoi (0.95x), Da Nang (0.85x), Other cities (0.75x). Remote positions typically offer 0.9-1.0x of HCM rates.
